text:
maria (Partner Ops): Quick sync — LangChain/LlamaIndex runner smokeplaybook. Partner demo next Tue, want to validate privacy edge cases (PII redaction, KV cache leakage, VPC connector behavior). Who can triage?

sam (Eng-Platform): I can take lead on infra smoke tests. Will run the gateway + runner end-to-end and validate network isolation.

deepa (Eng-ML): I'll validate the KV cache and prefix-caching behavior with quantized models — look for token leakage in reroutes.

chad (Solutions Eng): I can run partner-facing flows and repro steps. Any specific prompt sets we should use?

maria (Partner Ops): Use the partner sample set: https://confluence.redwood/partnerships/samples/lc-lindex-demo (public link for partner). Include docs for multi-tool chains and tool calling.

sam (Eng-Platform): For infra I'll run:
```bash
REMOTE_RUNNER=partner-sandbox ./scripts/smoke_runner.sh --profile gateway --timeout 60
```
I'll post logs to the thread.

deepa (Eng-ML): Quick note: for quantized float16 -> int8 paths the tokenization edge-case exists when tool args include commas and backticks. I'll add a test.

kevin (Legal): Heads-up — partner needs SOC2 attestation for private deployment demos. If we touch customer data even synthetic, mark it as synthetic. No live PII.

olivia (PM Partnerships): Confirmed with partner: they will provide synthetic dataset (anonymized tickets). They expect a short statement on how we mask PHI and how cache TTL works.

chad (Solutions Eng): Repro steps for partner flow: 1) start gateway helm chart with langchain adapter; 2) register runner via OAuth; 3) run sample chat with tool call that triggers LlamaIndex retrieval. If any KV leakage, capture request/response.

maria (Partner Ops): Ownership: Sam = infra smoke & network isolation; Deepa = model/cache checks; Chad = partner flow + repro; Kevin = legal checklist; Olivia = partner comms. I'll compile a one-pager by EOD. :thumbsup:

sam (Eng-Platform): Running first pass now, ETA 90m. Posting logs to /tmp/runner-smoke-2859123456.log and CI artifact via ci-bot.

ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/2859123456/runner-smoke-log.txt (sha256: 3f8b9...)

sam (Eng-Platform): Quick snippet from logs showing a 403 on VPC egress during tool call — looks like subnet NAT not enabled in sandbox cluster.
```
ERROR 403: egress blocked for 10.1.2.0/24 -> external-api.hostname
```

maria (Partner Ops): Noted. Chad, can you confirm partner can demo without external tool calls or provide a stub?

chad (Solutions Eng): I'll ask partner to switch to stubbed tool for demo. Also will record a short video of the full flow in case infra fixes take longer.

deepa (Eng-ML): Found one cache edge-case: when reranking attaches metadata keys with same name across tool calls, KV cache key normalization fails. Patch incoming?

sam (Eng-Platform): If deepa has repro we can apply a short-term TTL workaround (invalidate cache per-request) while ML fixes key normalization.

kevin (Legal): For the one-pager please include: no live customer data, data retention TTLs, who has access to logs, and how we mask PHI in retrieval hits. I'll review.

olivia (PM Partnerships): I'll draft comms to partner with the stub option and offer recorded demo as backup.

maria (Partner Ops): Next steps and timeline: Sam finish infra pass (90m), Deepa open PR for normalization fix (PR description must include test), Chad prepare stub + recording (today), Kevin review one-pager (ASAP), Olivia send partner note (after Kevin ok).

sam (Eng-Platform): Starting NAT fix now on sandbox cluster — should be quick. Will re-run smoke tests after.

deepa (Eng-ML): PR: https://git.redwood/eng-ml/kv-normalize/pull/212 — includes unit + integration test using the partner sample set.

chad (Solutions Eng): Recording link (draft): https://drive.redwood/recordings/2859123456-demo.mp4 (private until partner ok).

kevin (Legal): Reviewing one-pager now, will comment in Confluence doc.

maria (Partner Ops): Great — can we do a final sync tomorrow 11am PT to confirm green? I'll create a calendar invite.

olivia (PM Partnerships): 11am PT works for me.

sam (Eng-Platform): Works. If anything blocks I'll ping here.

chad (Solutions Eng): On it.

deepa (Eng-ML): Thanks team.

maria (Partner Ops): Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround :heart:
